info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to ooze, to drip, to trickle

info.name: padam
info.note: dyutAditvAt dyudByo luNiH 1.3.91 ityanena luNlakAre, taTA ca vftAditvAt vfdByaH syasanoH 1.3.92 ityanena sya' vikaraRapratyaye pare 'san' pratyaye ca pare vikalpena parasmEpadarUpARi api Bavanti .

examples: 'prasyandini' (gO॰Da॰2.7.42). prakfzwaM syandanaM varzaM prasyandaH, tadvati kAla iti sUtrArTaH.
'sa raTaM yuktvA. sukanyArTaM SaryAtImupADAya prasizyanda' (Sa॰brA॰4.1.5.6). tatvare ityarTaH. syado javo Bavati, syandanaSca javano'nudGAtI raTaH.
'pUrvamavivakzitasyArTasyAnantaraM svavAvaye samAropo nAwye'vasyanditamucyate.' taTA ca darpaRakArastallakzaRamAha.
'SamBumayoBUByAM vizyandayati' (kO0 sU0 43, 3-12). AsiYcatItyarTaH. mArutaM vizyandamAnaM (payaH). kvaTyamAnamityarTaH.
'mArutaM vizyandamAnam' (dugDam) (E0 brA0 5.26). arTavESadyAya BUyo'sya nyAsaH. vizyandamAnam UrDvamudgataM pAtrAd bahirviSezeRa syandanadaSApannam.
'yasyAgnihotramaDiSritaM skandati vA vizyandate vA' (E0 brA0 7.5). vizyando nAma jalakzIrayoragnisaMyoge kzIramaDaH kurvan jalamupari ca kurvan vyApAraH (zaqguruSizyaH).
'yadi tvAmIdfSaM rAmaBadraH paSyettadAsya hfdayaM snehenABizyandeta' (uttara0 5). aBizyandeta dravet prasravet. aBiraviSezakaH.
'prAyeRa sarve nayanAmayAste BavantyaBizyandanimittamUlAH' (suSruta0 uttara0 6.2). nayanAByAM jalabindunipatanamaBizyandaH.
'BUtapUrvamaBUtapUrvaM vA janapadaM paradeSApavAhanena svadeSABizyandavamanena vA niveSayet' (kO0 a0 2.1.1). aBizyando'tirekaH (prajAnAm).
'divAsvapnAt purovAtAd gurvaBizyandiBojanAt' (kA0 saM0 Kila0 sUtikopa0 Slo0 41). ukto'rTaH. navaM DAnyamaBizyandi laGu saMvatsarozitam ityAyurvedavidaH. aBizyandiramaRaM SAKAnagaramiti kozaH.
